display.purpose: Stage headline on the sign-in screen.

shadows.name: none-on-form
shadows.purpose: The sign-in form is flat; depth lives in the stage.

shadows.name: stage-seat-gradient
shadows.purpose: Bottom fade on the lower half of the stage behind the headline.

motion.name: scan-sequence
motion.value: layers drop, scan ring shades, layers separate with labels, re-stack
motion.purpose: Stage story loop; replaced by a still pose under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Hover and focus changes on buttons and inputs.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width crimson submit on the sign-in form.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #d4162a; color: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgb(212 22 42 / .9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(255 74 74 / .6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Auth Field
components.description: Labelled input on the black ground with rose stroke and focus-red ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 10px; width: 280px; color: #f6eeec; font-size: 14px; } .ds-input { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #86605f; border-radius: 6px; background: #0c0708; color: #f6eeec; font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: box-shadow .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #b3a0a0; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #ff4a4a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(255 74 74 / .3); }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Forgot-password link in soft signal red.
components.css: .ds-link { color: #ff8a82; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(255 74 74 / .6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stage Chip
components.description: Ghost pill on the stage that opts back into motion.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 6px 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .3); border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: rgb(255 255 255 / .9); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; transition: background-color .15s; } .ds-chip:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / .1); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The sign-in screen is a low-key food-photography table: a plated burger on dark oak, in the dark, lit warm from the front and red from behind. A red scan plane turns the raw wireframe mesh into the shaded dish, which is the product story (a photo becomes a 3D model). The form sits beside it as a calm, card-less column, so the stage carries the atmosphere and the form carries the task.
keyCharacteristics: Black and red, one crimson (#d4162a), no second accent in the UI
Stage left (about 58%), form right (about 42%); mirrored in RTL; stage is a 300px band on phones
Card-less form on the page ground; no panels, no shadows on the form
Bricolage Grotesque for display, Cairo for Arabic
Live 3D stage (lazy three.js) with still and no-WebGL fallbacks

rules.name: The One Crimson Rule
rules.body: Crimson is the action and the brand. Nothing else on the form is red-filled; links and focus use the lighter reds.

rules.name: The Text-Red Rule
rules.body: Red used as text on the dark ground is crimson-link, never the button crimson.

rules.name: The Display Is Headlines Rule
rules.body: font-display is for the stage headline, the wordmark and the form h1 only; fields, buttons and descriptions stay in the sans.

rules.name: The Depth Lives On The Stage Rule
rules.body: The form column stays flat; atmosphere is the stage's job.

dos: Do scope the world with the auth-dark class on the shell root and read bg-background, text-foreground, text-primary from it; add no new sign-in colours outside that block.
Do keep the form card-less, centred, 380px max, with the crimson button as the single filled element.
Do mirror the layout with dir and use logical utilities (start, end, pe, ms) so Arabic works.
Do keep a still and a no-WebGL state for any animated stage content.
Do carry provenance for every shipped raster, model and texture in CREDITS.md.
donts: Don't bring the app shell's orange primary (#c2410c / #f97316) onto signed-out screens, or crimson onto the dashboard without a decision.
Don't use button crimson as text colour on the dark ground.
Don't put the form in a card or add shadows to it.
Don't set body or form text in font-display.
